description: Fires in the opening (mostly 4-6 stones, strongest at exactly 4) right after the opponent drops a stone in column 1 or 0 (weaker for column 5 or 3; rarely for 2, 4, 6). It is stronger when my own stones sit in columns 3 and 5 and weaker when they sit in columns 0 or 4. It fades quickly as the board fills and is near zero after about 8 stones.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes no move probability by even 0.01 (activation range is tiny, ~0.007).
notes: Layer 0; act shows bag-of-tokens behaviour (order of earlier moves irrelevant). Dev F1: p1 (last col + ply) 0.624; p2 (+my-stone weights, even ply) 0.763; p3 recalibrated 0.784; p4 (my-stone weights at all plies, capped) 0.780, submitted p4. Simulation share nan (ceiling negative). No steer effect; tiny magnitude suggests this may be a random/weak direction, and the rule is closer to a token-weighting than a tactical concept.
